Record Class Ir.CompiledBody

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.Ir.CompiledBody
Record Components:
className - The generated class the method belongs to
methodName - The method
parameterNames - The parameter names, the receiver excluded
parameterTypes - The Java types of the parameters as the stub declares them
returnType - The Java return type as the stub declares it
body - The body
span - Where the Python function is declared
stats - What the body contains
wrapsCheckedExceptions - Whether a call of the body declares a checked exception, which the generated method rethrows unchecked as the bridge would
advised - Whether the method is advised: the generated method runs the interceptor chain the proxy binds before the body
staticMethod - Whether the body is generated as a static Java method: a static method of a class, or a plain function of a module
moduleLevel - Whether the function is a module-level function, generated into the module's class
exceptions - How the Java exception of a Python exception class the body throws reaches a Python caller of the rewritten function
pythonParameters - Per parameter, the Python name (Outer.Inner) of the plain class of the compilation whose generated class the parameter is, which wraps the Python object a Python caller passes, or an empty string
callsCompiledCode - Whether the body calls code of the compilation that computes a result of its own (a compiled function, a method of a Python class through its generated class), which may overflow where Python promotes
pythonEntries - What may make the body enter Python, which decides whether a route whose body it is runs on the event loop (see EventLoopSafety); null when the planner did not find it out
Enclosing interface:
Ir
public static record Ir.CompiledBody(String className, String methodName, List<String> parameterNames, List<String> parameterTypes, String returnType, Ir.Body body, @Nullable SourceSpan span, StaticCompilationDecision.Stats stats, boolean wrapsCheckedExceptions, boolean advised, boolean staticMethod, boolean moduleLevel, Ir.ExceptionCrossing exceptions, List<String> pythonParameters, boolean callsCompiledCode, @Nullable Ir.PythonEntries pythonEntries) extends Record

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
